data.title: Child supplement (Kinderzuschlag) application rejected
data.summary: The Familienkasse Muster-Mitte rejected your application of 6 October 2025 for child supplement (Kinderzuschlag) for October 2025 to March 2026. The household income exceeds the maximum income limit. The letter is dated 21 November 2025.
data.explanation: Your application for child supplement (Kinderzuschlag) was rejected because your household's income is above the upper income limit. If you disagree, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing, electronically or by recording it at the Familienkasse. The period is one month from notification, and the app shows the deadline. Check the calculation in the attachment, which was not included in the text. Consider getting advice from a counselling service if you are unsure.
